name: GotongHR WAF custom rules
description: Block probe paths and disallowed methods. Block the platform API unless Cloudflare Access credentials are present. Block scanners on auth paths without challenging Indonesian mobile or office networks.

rules.description: Block dotfiles, backups, and common probe paths. Leave /.well-known for ACME and app links.
rules.expression: ( ( http.request.uri.path contains "/." and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.well-known/") ) or http.request.uri.path contains "../" or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".bak") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".old") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".sql") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".zip") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".tar") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".tgz") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".swp") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".pem") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".key") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".ini") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".php") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".asp") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".aspx") or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/wp-admin" or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/wp-login" or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/phpmyadmin" or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/cgi-bin/" or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/server-status" or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/vendor/phpunit" )

rules.description: Block HTTP methods the API does not implement. OPTIONS stays allowed for same-origin and preflight requests.
Block /api/platform unless a Cloudflare Access JWT cookie, Access JWT header, or Access service token is present. Access still validates the credential. A spoofed header is not authentication.
rules.expression: ( ( http.request.uri.path eq "/api/platform" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/platform/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/v1/platform" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/v1/platform/") ) and not http.cookie contains "CF_Authorization=" and not any(http.request.headers["cf-access-jwt-assertion"][*] ne "") and not any(http.request.headers["cf-access-client-id"][*] ne "") )

rules.description: Block scanner user agents and traversal on /api/auth. Do not challenge by country, ASN, or bot score. Indonesian mobile CGNAT and office NAT must pass.
rules.expression: ( ( starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/auth/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/v1/auth/") ) and ( lower(http.user_agent) contains "sqlmap" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "nikto" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "nmap" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "masscan" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "nuclei" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "dirbuster" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "gobuster" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "zgrab" or http.request.uri.path contains "../" or http.request.uri.query contains "../" or http.request.uri.query contains "<script" ) )
